(<0|^{ot 3} (x) I^5)|sqrtT>^8 = 2^{-3/2}|sqrtT>^5, and verify_challenge/cert_sqrtt_galois_census.py on main already proves chi(|sqrtT>^5) = 6 in exact Q(zeta_16) / two-prime modular arithmetic over the 4D Galois-forced subspace V_4 and prints CERTIFIED chi(qubit_sqrtT^8) >= 6. With bounds/qubit_sqrtT-m8-upper-15.json (verified), the verified-tier interval at m = 8 is 6 <= chi(|sqrtT>^8) <= 15.
